generation.scope: At a simple five-space mark of any curvilinear finite graph with full middle support, projected evaluation valuations exclude every ruling. Six reduced nodes force a secant collision at a nonsimple graph point, and a conic with two detached reduced nodes forces symmetry. For seventeen simple points and one curvilinear triple point, opposite rank ten forces symmetry and rank eleven is impossible.

open_mathematics: Treat the two-double graph. In the five-node degeneration, compare the confluent square relations for the four simple nodes and one dual-number node. For the conic plus an embedded point test whether the two moving pencils at distinct conic secants can simultaneously exhaust the two excess lengths. Analyze the commutator discriminant on the one-sided symmetric rank-ten branch.
